title: Hangboard Protocol Load Personal Best Detection
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hangboard:protocol
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats max(load_kg) as prior_best current=f
| where isnotnull(prior_best) AND load_kg>prior_best
| table _time grip_type load_kg prior_best
description: Scans your hangboard protocol load history in time order and highlights any entry that set a new personal best using the higher metric direction.
value: Automatic personal-best detection turns long history tables into a clean milestone log that is motivating and easy to review.
implementation: Keep the underlying metric normalized across sessions so the best-detection logic compares like events with like events.
visualization: Table of personal-best events with the previous best beside the new value.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the moments when hangboard protocol load reached a new best for you.
